en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ali b. Majluwayh from Muhammad b. Yahya al-’Attar from Muhammad b. Ahmad b. al-Saqr from Abi Qatadah from al-Ridha (a.s.) who said: “
Repeating ablution for Isha prayer wipes the sins concerning oaths (yes, by Allah; no, by Allah)”
